Hi Elena 

Thanks — happy to run the demo. Quick note on the timings: when times are listed without an explicit timezone the calendar system and attendees sometimes interpret them differently (PT vs CET vs local). To avoid that, can we pick the time and call out the timezone + UTC offset in the invite? Example conversions so we're synced: 

If you mean "Wednesday 9:00" CET (CEST / UTC+02:00):
- CEST/UTC+02:00: Wednesday 09:00
- PT (Pacific Daylight Time / UTC-07:00): Wednesday 00:00
- ET (Eastern Daylight Time / UTC-04:00): Wednesday 03:00
- IST (India Standard Time / UTC+05:30): Wednesday 12:30

If you mean "Wednesday 9:00" PT (UTC-07:00):
- PT: Wednesday 09:00
- ET: Wednesday 12:00
- CEST: Wednesday 18:00
- IST: Wednesday 21:30

To avoid confusion, my preference is that the calendar invite subject includes both a regional label and the UTC offset, e.g.:
  "Demo — FinMira — 2026-06-16 15:00 CEST (UTC+02:00) / 06:00 PT"

Ive attached a quick availability .ics (Attachment: availability.ics) with a few slots in PT labeled explicitly. If youd rather standardize on CEST in your invites, we can convert on our end before sending.

Priyom and Monica are ccd to help finalize scheduling and to coordinate the demo materials.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
